title: refactor: simplify Inkling audio adapter
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps the public OpenAI `input_audio` shape and only converts it to Fireworks `audio_url`.
- Forwards base64 bytes unchanged; only maps the Opus format label to its Ogg container MIME type.
- Removes local base64/container validation and raw PCM16-to-WAV transcoding, leaving unsupported-format errors to Fireworks.
- Verified the exact Fireworks Inkling route with WAV, MP3, FLAC, and Ogg/Opus; all returned 200.

Tests: focused Vitest, Gen TypeScript typecheck, Biome, and local `/v1/chat/completions` audio requests.

gist.headline: Audio takes the scenic route
gist.blurb: Inkling audio now travels with fewer homemade checkpoints. Polli stopped repacking sound files and lets Fireworks read the originals as nature intended.
gist.summary: Simplified the Inkling audio adapter so OpenAI-style input_audio is forwarded as Fireworks audio_url data unchanged, mapping only Opus to its Ogg MIME type and supporting verified WAV, MP3, FLAC, and Ogg/Opus requests.
gist.impact: Developers can send common audio formats to /v1/chat/completions with less local conversion logic, while Fireworks handles format validation directly.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy audio delivery route: Polli carries several clearly distinct sound parcels—a WAV cassette, MP3 music note, FLAC file, and Ogg/Opus disc—straight into a warmly glowing retro Fireworks-style audio terminal, bypassing an unnecessary maze of converters. Small code-plants and flowers reinforce that a simpler adapter path lets more audio formats grow naturally.
